Subjam is strongly opposed to using generative AI in the creative space.

"Code is art", an age old hacker mantra, proclaims that software problems can be solved in many ways and that striving to write elegant/beautiful/efficient code is, in fact, a creative endeavor.

What's your opinion on using AI in software dev? We'd love to get feedback from the Fedi. ✌️
